transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well, nice to meet you, doctor. I guess I'm here because I just don't have the push I used to have. 

I used to do a lot—choir, my quilting, visiting folks. But lately, most days I just sit at home. I keep the TV on low and just sit there. I know people are expecting me to show up to things, but I just don't go.
Have you been feeling down or sad most of the day?

No, I wouldn't say I feel sad. I don't sit there crying or feeling down in the dumps, if that's what you mean. I just... don't feel much of anything, really. It's more like I just don't care enough to get up and do things anymore.
Has this lack of interest and motivation been going on for at least two years?
Yes, I'd say so. It's been building up for a while now. I guess it really started right around when I retired from the school office, and that was a little over two years ago.
Even though you don’t feel sad, do you ever feel down or depressed most of the day?

No, I don't think I'd call it depressed. It's not like a heavy cloud hanging over me or feeling bad about things. I just... I really just feel empty, like I was saying. I just don't have the energy or the care to do much, but it's not a depressed feeling.
Have you ever had a time when you felt depressed or down most of the day for at least two weeks?

No, I haven't. I've never really had a time where I felt sad or down for a couple of weeks straight. It's... well, it's just like I was saying before. I just feel empty and don't have the drive to do much, but I wouldn't call it depression.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No, it's really just like I was saying a minute ago. I don't feel depressed every day. I don't feel depressed at all, really. It's just... well, it's just that empty feeling, but no sadness.
Have you noticed any problems with your memory or concentration?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My memory is fine. And I can pay attention to things if I need to. I just... well, like I said, I don't always have the energy to do much, but my mind works alright. I don't have any trouble remembering things.
Did these changes start after a new illness, medication, or other medical problem?
No, nothing like that. I haven't been sick with anything new, and I'm not taking any new pills or anything. It didn't start from a medical problem... it just sort of came on its own.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or sad most of the day nearly every day?
No, I really haven't. Like I said, I don't feel sad or depressed. I've never had a time like that, not for two weeks or... or any amount of time, really. It's just the emptiness, not sadness.
Do you often feel like you’re not good enough or a failure?
No, I don't think so. I don't really sit around feeling like a failure or that I'm not good enough. I just... I just feel kind of blank most days. But I don't beat myself up about things like that.
Have you felt depressed or down most of the day, nearly every day, at any time during the past two years?
No, I haven't. Like I was saying just a minute ago, I don't feel depressed or down. Not now, and not over the past two years either. I just don't have those kinds of feelings.
How has your sleep been lately?
My sleep has been fine, really. I just... I go to bed and sleep through the night mostly. I haven't noticed any trouble with it.
Do you often feel like you’re not good enough or like a failure?
You just asked me that, Doctor. Like I said before, no. I don't feel like a failure or that I'm not good enough. I just feel kind of empty, but I don't get down on myself like that.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. That's really what brings me in, to be honest. I just don't have the push I used to have for things like choir, or my quilting, or visiting folks. Most days... I just sit at home with the TV on low, even though I know people are expecting me to show up.
